SELECT M.MILESTONE_ID, M.MILESTONE_NAME, M.DUE_DATE, M.PROJECT_ID, M.DESCRIPTION, M.STATUS, COUNT(T.TASK_ID) AS TOTAL_TASKS,
SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_TASKS,
SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID=1 THEN 1 WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INPROGRESS_TASKS,
CASE WHEN COUNT(T.TASK_ID) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(AVG(NVL(T.PROGRESS_RATE,0))) END AS PROGRESS_RATE
FROM MILESTONES M LEFT JOIN TASKS T ON M.MILESTONE_ID = T.MILESTONE_ID WHERE M.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND M.STATUS = 'E1' GROUP BY M.MILESTONE_ID, M.MILESTONE_NAME, M.DUE_DATE, M.PROJECT_ID, M.DESCRIPTION, M.STATUS ORDER BY M.MILESTONE_ID

SELECT DISTINCT M.MILESTONE_NAME, M.MILESTONE_ID, M.START_DATE, M.DUE_DATE, M.DESCRIPTION FROM MILESTONES M JOIN PROJECTS P ON P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = M.PROJECT_ID WHERE P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND M.STATUS='E1' ORDER BY M.MILESTONE_ID

SELECT P.PROJECT_ID, P.PROJECT_NAME, P.SUB_PL_USER_ID, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, M.MILESTONE_ID, M.MILESTONE_NAME, U.USER_NAME FROM PROJECTS P JOIN MILESTONE_MAPPING MM ON P.PROJECT_ID = MM.PROJECT_ID JOIN MILESTONES M ON MM.MILESTONE_ID = M.MILESTONE_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = P.SUB_PL_USER_ID WHERE P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND M.MILESTONE_ID = #{milestoneId} ORDER BY P.PROJECT_ID

SELECT T.TITLE, T.TASK_ID, T.PROJECT_ID, T.TASK_STATUS_ID, T.TASK_TYPE_ID, T.MILESTONE_ID, T.START_DATE, T.EST_END_DATE, T.PROGRESS_RATE, U.USER_NAME, TT.TYPE_NAME, T.PRIORITY_CODE, CC.CODE_NAME FROM TASKS T JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID=T.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID JOIN PROJECTS P ON P.PROJECT_ID = T.PROJECT_ID JOIN TASK_TYPES TT ON TT.TASK_TYPE_ID = T.TASK_TYPE_ID JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.CODE_VALUE = T.PRIORITY_CODE WHERE P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL AND T.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND T.MILESTONE_ID = #{milestoneId}
